# M1-02 — Stakeholder Analysis & Register

## Labels
`docs`, `milestone-1`, `priority-high`

## Milestone
Milestone 1 — Engineering Foundation & Requirements Baseline

## Tasks
- [ ] Identify all relevant stakeholder groups (requesters, staff, management/oversight, and any others)
- [ ] Document each stakeholder's needs, influence and interest
- [ ] Identify at least one meaningful conflict or competing expectation between stakeholders
- [ ] Explain how the conflict was reconciled or will be managed
- [ ] Derive at least 2–3 example requirements directly from the stakeholder register
- [ ] Integrate the Stakeholder Register into PED v1.0

## Acceptance Criteria
- Register includes stakeholder name/role, needs, influence/interest, and notes.
- At least one genuine competing-expectation conflict is documented and analysed (not invented for form).
- Each derived requirement example references its source stakeholder.
- Ready to defend: "which stakeholder expectation was hardest to reconcile, and how did it affect scope/requirements?"
